title: Bard Instruments

__TOC__
List of instruments for bards. Instruments act as a multiplier for certain effects from bard songs.
For example, if you're playing a percussion song and are using [[Drums of the Beast]], the song will have a 2.6x multiplier (+1.6x, aka Percussion Resonance 16).
